description: National layers available for all projects — loaded automatically. Add a state with a new regions/<state>.json file and zero code changes.

groups.label: Basemap
groups.description: Background map — only one basemap is shown at a time.

layers.name: USGS Topo
layers.description: Official USGS topographic map with contour lines, roads, trails, and land features. The standard reference for backcountry navigation.
layers.attribution: U.S. Geological Survey — The National Map
layers.license: Public Domain — U.S. Government work, 17 U.S.C. § 105

layers.name: USGS Imagery
layers.description: High-resolution aerial photography from the USGS National Map. Useful for scouting terrain and vegetation.
layers.attribution: U.S. Geological Survey — The National Map
layers.license: Public Domain — U.S. Government work, 17 U.S.C. § 105

layers.name: Imagery + Topo
layers.description: Aerial imagery with topographic features overlaid. A hybrid view combining the best of both basemaps.
layers.attribution: U.S. Geological Survey — The National Map
layers.license: Public Domain — U.S. Government work, 17 U.S.C. § 105

groups.label: Terrain
groups.description: Terrain visualization overlays. Stack these on top of any basemap.

layers.name: Shaded Relief
layers.description: 3D hillshade derived from USGS 3DEP elevation data. Makes terrain readable at any zoom level.
layers.license: Public Domain — U.S. Government work, 17 U.S.C. § 105

layers.name: Contour Lines
layers.description: Elevation contours from USGS 3DEP. Index contours are bold and labeled; intermediates are lighter.
layers.license: Public Domain — U.S. Government work, 17 U.S.C. § 105

layers.name: Slope Shading
layers.description: Colour-coded slope steepness from 3DEP elevation. Darker = steeper. Useful for route planning.
layers.license: Public Domain — U.S. Government work, 17 U.S.C. § 105

groups.label: Land Access
groups.description: Land access categories derived from federal and state land management data. Access categories are estimates — verify before you hunt.

layers.name: Open — Hunting Allowed
layers.description: Public land you can enter and hunt on, subject to season and license requirements.
layers.attribution: PAD-US v3.0 (USGS Protected Areas Database); classification by Hunting Map Generator rules engine

layers.name: Open — No Hunting
layers.description: Public land you can walk on, but hunting is prohibited.
layers.attribution: PAD-US v3.0 (USGS Protected Areas Database); classification by Hunting Map Generator rules engine

layers.name: Closed — No Public Entry
layers.description: Public or restricted land you may not enter at all.
layers.attribution: PAD-US v3.0 (USGS Protected Areas Database); classification by Hunting Map Generator rules engine

layers.name: Private Land
layers.description: Private property — written permission required to enter.
layers.attribution: PAD-US v3.0 (USGS Protected Areas Database); county parcel data; classification by Hunting Map Generator rules engine

layers.name: Unknown / Unclassified
layers.description: Access status could not be determined from available data. Treat as closed until independently verified.
layers.attribution: PAD-US v3.0 (USGS Protected Areas Database); classification by Hunting Map Generator rules engine

layers.name: Public Access Routes
layers.description: Roads, trails, and easements the public may legally travel, including routes crossing private land.
layers.attribution: USFS Motor Vehicle Use Map (MVUM); USGS National Map; WGFD and county easement data
layers.license: Public Domain — U.S. Government work, 17 U.S.C. § 105

groups.label: Features
groups.description: Roads, trails, and water drawn on top of the basemap.

layers.name: Roads
layers.description: Road network from USGS National Map and OpenStreetMap — paved, gravel, and unimproved roads.
layers.attribution: U.S. Geological Survey, The National Map Transportation; © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL)

layers.name: Trails
layers.description: Hiking and foot trails from USGS National Map and OpenStreetMap.
layers.attribution: U.S. Geological Survey, The National Map; © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL)

layers.name: Motor Vehicle Routes (MVUM)
layers.description: USFS Motor Vehicle Use Map — roads and trails open to motorized use on National Forest land.
layers.attribution: USDA Forest Service — Motor Vehicle Use Map
layers.license: Public Domain — U.S. Government work, 17 U.S.C. § 105

layers.name: Water Features
layers.description: Rivers, streams, lakes, and wetlands from the USGS National Hydrography Dataset (NHD).
layers.attribution: U.S. Geological Survey — National Hydrography Dataset (NHD)
layers.license: Public Domain — U.S. Government work, 17 U.S.C. § 105

layers.name: Land Management Boundaries
layers.description: Federal and state managed land boundary lines from PAD-US. Shows where different agencies manage land.
layers.attribution: U.S. Geological Survey — Protected Areas Database of the US (PAD-US) v3.0
layers.license: Public Domain — U.S. Government work, 17 U.S.C. § 105
